notes.title: First Patch
notes.summary: The first update delivered through the new Update button, with two small fixes found while testing the installed app.

items.title: Version in the window title
items.text: The window title now reads "MediaDesk V0.4.1" instead of just "MediaDesk", so you can always see which version you're on, even from the taskbar.

items.title: Esc closes pop-ups
items.text: Every pop-up (new client, edit project, file preview, What's new…) now closes with the Esc key. If the country list is open inside a pop-up, Esc closes just the list first.
